## Frequentist result

### City example

```{r}
plot_coef_sp_city <- function(r_output_dir, level = "Factor", phe_types){
  coef_summary <- data.frame()
  coef_summary <- map_dfr(
      phe_types,
      ~ read_rds(paste0(r_output_dir, .x, "_summary.rds")) %>%
          mutate(phe_type = .x)
    )
  
  load("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/tree_species.RData") # phylo_tree
  class_tree <- phylo_tree
  df_filtered <- coef_summary %>%
      filter(.data[[level]] %in% class_tree$tip.label)
  class_used   <- unique(df_filtered[[level]])
  tree_sub  <- drop.tip(class_tree,
                        setdiff(class_tree$tip.label, class_used))
  class_order <- tree_sub$tip.label 
  
  coef_df_plot <- df_filtered |>
    mutate(
      !!level := factor(.data[[level]], levels = rev(class_order))
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Color = case_when(
        is.na(Color) ~ "grey95",
        TRUE ~ Color
      ),
      SigAlpha = case_when(
        is.na(SigAlpha) ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ SigAlpha
      ),
      !!level := factor(.data[[level]], levels = rev(class_order))
    )
  coef_df_plot$phe_type <- factor(coef_df_plot$phe_type,
                                levels = c("SOS", "EOS"))
  p_coef <-  ggplot(coef_df_plot, aes(x = Factor, 
                               y = Estimate,
                               color = Color
                               )) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = SigAlpha, color = Color), position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, alpha = SigAlpha, color = Color), 
                  position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), 
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    labs(x = "Species", y = bquote(beta[Temp]~" estimate")) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text = element_blank()) +
    # coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ phe_type, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_color_identity() +
    # geom_text(aes(label = Sig, y = Upper + 0.05  ), hjust = -0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    # geom_text(aes(label = Estimate, y = Estimate  ), vjust = -0.7, show.legend = FALSE, size = 3) +
    guides(alpha = "none")
  
  tree_plot <- ggtree(tree_sub) +
    layout_dendrogram()
  
  p_combined <- tree_plot / p_coef +
    plot_layout(heights = c(2, 20))
  
  return(p_combined)
}

city = "NewYork"
phe_types = c("SOS", "EOS")
r_output_dir <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/freq/NewYork/canonicalname/")
```

### all cities heatmap

```{r input-heatmap}
#| include: false
### Group by city and phe_type
tree_dir <- "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/"
rds_files <- list.files(tree_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
cities <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_files))
phe_types <- c("SOS", "EOS")

coef_summary_all <- data.frame()

for (city in cities) {
  r_output_dir <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/freq/", city, "/canonicalname/")
  for (phe_type in phe_types) {
    file_path <- file.path(r_output_dir, paste0(phe_type, "_summary.rds"))
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      coef_summary <- readr::read_rds(file_path) |>
        dplyr::mutate(phe_type = phe_type, city = city)
      coef_summary_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_summary_all, coef_summary)
    }
  }
}
coef_summary_all <- coef_summary_all |>
  mutate(phe_type = factor(phe_type, levels = c("SOS", "EOS")),
         genus = sub(" .*", "", Factor),
         species = Factor) |>
  left_join(
    readr::read_rds("~/phenology-urban/temp/tree_genus_family.rds"),
    by = "genus")

inventory_centroids <- readRDS(("~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/inventory_centroids.rds"))
boundary_us <- st_read(("~/lab-data/datasets/boundary/USAdministrative/US/us_boundarydissolve.shp"), quiet = T) |>
  st_transform(4326)

load("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/tree_species.RData") # phylo_tree
load("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/tree_genus.RData") # tree_genus
load("~/phenology-urban/temp/tree_family.RData") # tree_family

city_feature <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/city_feature.rds") |>
  select(-bio1, -bio12) |>
  left_join(read_rds("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/city_bioclimate.rds") |>
              select(site, bio1, bio12), by = "site") |>
  rename(city = site) |>
  mutate(city = ifelse(city == "St_George", "StGeorge", city)) |>
  mutate(city = ifelse(city == "St.Louis", "StLouis", city))
```

### spatial map

```{r}
#| include: false
city_mean <- coef_summary_all |>
  group_by(city, phe_type) |>
  summarise(
    avg = mean(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd  = sd(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_results_loc <- inventory_centroids |>
  left_join(city_mean, by = c("site" ="city")) |>
  # left_join(city_feature, by = c("site" ="city")) |>
  mutate(lon = st_coordinates(x)[, 1],
         lat = st_coordinates(x)[, 2],
         phe_type = factor(phe_type, levels = c("SOS", "EOS")))

sos_range_vals <- range(model_results_loc |> filter(phe_type == "SOS") |> pull(avg), na.rm = TRUE)
eos_range_vals <- range(model_results_loc |> filter(phe_type == "EOS") |> pull(avg), na.rm = TRUE)
tau_vals <- unique(model_results_loc$sd) |> na.omit()
tau_breaks <- pretty(range(tau_vals), n = 5)

chelsa_ras_us <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/tree_origin/chelsa_map/chelsa_us.tif")
bio1 <- chelsa_ras_us[[1]]
bio12 <- chelsa_ras_us[[2]]

p_sos = ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_us , fill = "white", color = "transparent") +
  tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = bio1, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")),
    name = "bio1 (°C)",
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_us , fill = "transparent", color = "grey85") +
  geom_point(data = model_results_loc |> 
               filter(phe_type == "SOS"),
             aes(x = lon, y = lat, text = site,
                 size   = (sd)),
             shape  = 21,
             stroke = 1, # acts as the thickness of the boundary line
             colour = "grey20" # acts as the color of the boundary line
             ) +
  geom_point(
    data = model_results_loc |> 
      filter(phe_type == "SOS"),
    aes(x = lon, y = lat,  text = site, color = avg, size = sd), alpha =0.7
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    name = "Mean estimated\neffect",
    colors = c("#FCA636FF", "white", "#0D0887FF"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(round(sos_range_vals[1], 1), 0, round(sos_range_vals[2], 1))),
    breaks = c(round(sos_range_vals[1], 1), 0, round(sos_range_vals[2], 1)),
    limits = c(round(sos_range_vals[1], 1), round(sos_range_vals[2], 1)),
  )+
  facet_wrap(~ phe_type, ncol = 1) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Among-species variance",
    breaks = (tau_breaks),
    labels = (tau_breaks)^2,
    range = c(3, 12),
    limits = range(tau_vals)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_colorbar(order = 1),

  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)

p_eos = ggplot() +
```

### Marginal

```{r}
species_vec <- c(
  "Acer saccharinum",
  "Acer rubrum",
  "Pyrus calleryana",
  "Quercus rubra",
  "Gleditsia triacanthos",
  "Ulmus americana",
  "Ginkgo biloba",
  "Acer platanoides",
  "Fraxinus pennsylvanica",
  "Tilia cordata"
)

city_inven_backbone <- read_rds("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/city_inven_backbone.rds")

city_inven_backbone_filtered <- city_inven_backbone |>
  filter(
    kingdom == "Plantae", phylum == "Tracheophyta",
    rank %in% c("GENUS", "SPECIES"),
    status %in% c("ACCEPTED", "SYNONYM")
  )

city_inven_backbone_filtered_consolidated <- city_inven_backbone_filtered |>
  mutate(usageKey = if_else(status == "SYNONYM", acceptedUsageKey, usageKey))

overlap_city_species_range <- coef_summary_all |>
  left_join(city_inven_backbone_filtered_consolidated |>
              select(usageKey, verbatim_name), by = c("Factor" = "verbatim_name")) |>
  left_join(read_rds("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/tree_origin/chelsa/sp_chelsa_summary.rds"),
            by = c("usageKey" = "specieskey")) |>
  left_join(city_feature |> 
              mutate(city = ifelse(city == "St_George", "StGeorge", city)) |>
              mutate(city = ifelse(city == "St.Louis", "StLouis", city)) |>              
              st_drop_geometry(), by = "city")

overlap_city_species_range_model <- overlap_city_species_range |>
  mutate(hot_edge = bio1 - bio1_p95,
         cold_edge = bio1_p5 - bio1,
         d_temp = bio1 - bio1_median,
         d_prcp = bio12 - bio12_median,
         temp_breadth = bio1_p95 - bio1_p5,
         prcp_breadth = bio12_p95 - bio12_p5,
         dry_edge = bio12 - bio12_p5)  |>
  select(-bio1, -bio12, -species)# larger value: further away from the edge 

source("~/phenology-urban/script/fit_pglmm_model.R")
load("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/tree_species.RData")


clim = "bio12"
phe_type = "EOS"
x_lab <- if (rlang::as_name(clim) %in% c("bio1")) {
  expression("Mean annual temperature ("*degree*C*")")
} else if (rlang::as_name(clim) %in% c("bio12")) {
  "Mean annual precipitation (mm)"
} else {
  rlang::as_name(clim)
}

pred_df <- lapply(
  species_vec,
  function(sp) {
    fit_uni(
      phe_type = phe_type, input_data = overlap_city_species_range_model, city_feature = city_feature, species_name = sp, clim = clim, bootstrap = T)$pred_table
  }
) |>
  bind_rows()

fit_input_df <- overlap_city_species_range_model |>
  left_join(city_feature, by = "city") |>
  filter(Factor %in% species_vec, phe_type == !!phe_type) |>
  select(Estimate, Lower, Upper, !!clim, Factor)
x_vals <- fit_input_df[[clim]]
x_min  <- min(x_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max  <- max(x_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
x_rng  <- x_max - x_min

p_EOS <- ggplot(fit_input_df, aes(x = .data[[clim]], y = Estimate, color = Factor)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), alpha = 0.1, size = 0.2) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_df,
              aes(x = .data[[clim]], ymin = y_lwr, ymax = y_upr, fill = species),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df,
            aes(x = .data[[clim]], y = y_pred, color = species),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            linewidth = 0.5) +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_min - 0.15 * x_rng, x_max)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-30, 30)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = x_lab,
    y = paste0("Estimated effect on ", phe_type),
    color = "Species",
    fill  = "Species"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "italic")
    # axis.title = element_blank()
  )
```

### City example

```{r}
plot_coef_sp_city <- function(r_output_dir, level = "Factor", phe_types){
  coef_summary <- data.frame()
  coef_summary <- map_dfr(
      phe_types,
      ~ read_rds(paste0(r_output_dir, .x, "_summary.rds")) %>%
          mutate(phe_type = .x)
    ) |>
    mutate(!!rlang::sym(level) := gsub("_", " ", .data[[level]]))
  
  load("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/inla/spatial_spde/tree_species.RData") # phylo_tree
  class_tree <- phylo_tree
  df_filtered <- coef_summary %>%
      filter(.data[[level]] %in% class_tree$tip.label)
  class_used   <- unique(df_filtered[[level]])
  tree_sub  <- drop.tip(class_tree,
                        setdiff(class_tree$tip.label, class_used))
  class_order <- tree_sub$tip.label 
  
  coef_df_plot <- df_filtered |>
    mutate(
      !!level := factor(.data[[level]], levels = rev(class_order))
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Color = case_when(
        is.na(Color) ~ "grey95",
        TRUE ~ Color
      ),
      SigAlpha = case_when(
        is.na(SigAlpha) ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ SigAlpha
      ),
      !!level := factor(.data[[level]], levels = rev(class_order))
    )
  coef_df_plot$phe_type <- factor(coef_df_plot$phe_type,
                                levels = c("SOS", "EOS"))
  p_coef <-  ggplot(coef_df_plot, aes(x = .data[[level]], 
                               y = Estimate,
                               color = Color
                               )) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = SigAlpha, color = Color), position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, alpha = SigAlpha, color = Color), 
                  position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), 
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    labs(x = "Species", y = bquote(beta[Temp]~" estimate")) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text = element_blank()) +
    # coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ phe_type, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_color_identity() +
    # geom_text(aes(label = Sig, y = Upper + 0.05  ), hjust = -0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    # geom_text(aes(label = Estimate, y = Estimate  ), vjust = -0.7, show.legend = FALSE, size = 3) +
    guides(alpha = "none")
  
  tree_plot <- ggtree(tree_sub) +
    layout_dendrogram()
  
  p_combined <- tree_plot / p_coef +
    plot_layout(heights = c(2, 20))
  
  return(p_combined)
}
```

```{r input-heatmap}
tree_dir <- "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/"

for (city in cities) {
  r_output_dir <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_clean_outlier/mcmc/spatial_mat/", city, "/canonicalname/")
  for (phe_type in phe_types) {

    if (file.exists(file_path)) {

        dplyr::mutate(phe_type = phe_type, city = city)

  }
```

```{r}
overlap_city_species_range_model <- overlap_city_species_range |>
  mutate(hot_edge = bio1 - bio1_p95,
         cold_edge = bio1_p5 - bio1,
         d_temp = bio1 - bio1_median,
         d_prcp = bio12 - bio12_median,

         prcp_breadth = bio12_p95 - bio12_p5,
```
